1077|75241b9c.name: Prospector Whelgar
1077|75241b9c.text: Oh my, this is quite historical.  A monumental find.  But these wretched beasts!  Merrin seems to be handling the situation quite well.  Now if I could just piece together this complicated puzzle. . . .

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

12657|fc20b897.name: Don Pompa
12657|fc20b897.text:
This dock here? Well, you can catch the ship that goes to Southshore, and then stops at that $r place after. What's its name? Uhh... Auberdine, I think.

I don't really know for sure, I just load and unload stuff.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

3136|b873f90f.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|b873f90f.text: Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

3179|c2467ddc.name: Harold Riggs
3179|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3691|3e6c050b.name: Raene Wolfrunner
3691|3e6c050b.text: I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

3692|6e5dc9aa.name: Volcor
3692|6e5dc9aa.text:
Well, the way I see it, $N, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.

We can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.

I'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.

3692|966370fe.name: Volcor
3692|966370fe.text:
<Volcor doesn't look at you at all as you get close to him. He seems to be concentrating on keeping his bandages from falling off. After a moment, he looks up at you, a little startled.>

Oh, sorry, $c. Now's not a good time. I hope you understand.

3845|10ec66f1.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
3845|10ec66f1.text: We elves have a long history.  Let us hope this history does not return to haunt us.

4077|a1373701.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
4077|a1373701.text:
If I can get the proper ingredients, we can create some explosives that will not only allow me to damage the Venture's Co.'s operations, but also cause a distraction.

I know you're impressed, but it gets better... I'll tell you more soon enough.

4078|8a5b6577.name: Collin Mauren
4078|8a5b6577.text: Hello, friend. What can I do for you?

4087|1c27b384.name: Arias'ta Bladesinger
4087|1c27b384.text: Greetings.  Do you seek instruction in art of war?

5114|5e0897b4.name: Bilban Tosslespanner
5114|5e0897b4.text: Excellent! You meet the required parameters and specifications. What can I do for you?

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

7315|08830bac.name: Darnath Bladesinger
7315|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

7315|4bb9e8d2.name: Darnath Bladesinger
7315|4bb9e8d2.text: Greetings.  You seek instruction in the art of war?

1007-accept.name: Talen
1007-accept.text:
I would charge you with a task, $N.

I was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws!  I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp.

But when I reached the shore and ran... my prized possession was lost.

Please, $N, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette.  It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.
1007-accept.title: The Ancient Statuette

1007-complete.name: Talen
1007-complete.text:
You found it!  Thank you, $N!

The old city of Zoram holds many secrets, and this statuette may be the key to many of them.
1007-complete.title: The Ancient Statuette

1008-accept.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-accept.text:
There is evil lurking on our northwestern coast, known as the Zoram Strand.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas.  It has been lost to the night elves for ages.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!

Return to me when your mission is complete.
1008-accept.title: The Zoram Strand

1008-complete.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-complete.text:
Very well done, $N.  Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.

I know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves.  We know this, for we share a history with them.

It is a history I care not to repeat.
1008-complete.title: The Zoram Strand

1008-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-progress.text: We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, $N.  It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
1008-progress.title: The Zoram Strand

101-complete.name: Madame Eva
101-complete.text: Very wise of you, $N.  This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout Azeroth and beyond.  When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura.  Be brave, fair $c.  You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
101-complete.title: The Totem of Infliction

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

1010-accept.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-accept.text:
There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north.  The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.

There is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness.  Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair?  I may need it to properly treat the child.

Bathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to Darkshore.
1010-accept.title: Bathran's Hair

1010-complete.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-complete.text:
Ah, you have the hair!  Now I will mix a cure for the child, and pray my concoction works.

And... Forsaken are at Bathran's Haunt?  Very troubling to hear, that is.  Very troubling indeed...
1010-complete.title: Bathran's Hair

1010-progress.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-progress.text: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $N?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
1010-progress.title: Bathran's Hair

1020-accept.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1020-accept.text:
$N, I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child.  Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.

To reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.
1020-accept.title: Orendil's Cure

1020-complete.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-complete.text:
This is from Orendil?

His skill with herbs and healing is great.  This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
1020-complete.title: Orendil's Cure

1020-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-progress.text: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
1020-progress.title: Orendil's Cure

1023-accept.name: Teronis' Corpse
1023-accept.text:
As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition.

You take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is.

The only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...
1023-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1023-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1023-complete.text:
This is terrible, $N. Teronis is dead?!

The time for mourning will come, but for now we must focus our efforts. I shall send some of the Sentinels to recover Teronis' body as soon as possible.

You have Teronis' journal and the gem he was seeking. Do you think you're capable of completing his task? I would rest much better knowing his death was not in vain.
1023-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

1024-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1024-accept.text:
You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left.

A dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. Seek her out.

Keep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
1024-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1025-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1025-accept.text:
Before you travel to the moonwell I have another task that will aid the people of Ashenvale if you would like to test your skills.

Along the road heading east before the Falfarren River, furbolgs have been attacking travelers. Their tortured minds feeding upon fear, and their appetites satiated by the blood of innocents.

Aid the Sentinels in protecting the lands by showing those monsters the same mercy they have shown our kind.

I believe their camps are south of the road... be careful.
1025-accept.title: An Aggressive Defense

1033-accept.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-accept.text:
I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child.  We must find more powerful medicine!  Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

Elune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar.  Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, $N, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
1033-accept.title: Elune's Tear

1033-complete.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-complete.text:
Oh, you found it!  I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.

Thank you!  Thank you, $N!
1033-complete.title: Elune's Tear

1033-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-progress.text: $N, did you find Iris Lake?  Do you have the Tear?
1033-progress.title: Elune's Tear

1034-accept.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-accept.text:
Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness.  Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing.  But ... fever still rages within her.

Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust.  Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever.  Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.

The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, $N.  May Elune speed your journey.
1034-accept.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1034-complete.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-complete.text:
You gathered the dust!  I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.

Thank you again, $N.  Without your help, my child would surely perish.
1034-complete.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1034-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-progress.text: Do you yet have the Stardust, $N?
1034-progress.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1035-accept.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1035-accept.text:
Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak.  I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost.  I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.

We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.

Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them.  Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.

And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.
1035-accept.title: Fallen Sky Lake

1054-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-accept.text:
Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.

Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now.

I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. Elune be with you.
1054-accept.title: Culling the Threat

1054-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-complete.text:
Well done, $N.

We are under constant threat from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.
1054-complete.title: Culling the Threat

1054-progress.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-progress.text: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
1054-progress.title: Culling the Threat

1056-accept.name: Faldreas Goeth'Shael
1056-accept.text:
The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.

To the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.

There awaits Keeper Albagorm. Heed his bidding, $r.

The journey will be perilous.
1056-accept.title: Journey to Stonetalon Peak

1057-accept.name: Keeper Albagorm
1057-accept.text:
As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.

You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.

The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.

Drive the wretched harpies out, $N!
1057-accept.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

1057-complete.name: Keeper Albagorm
1057-complete.text: Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....
1057-complete.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

1059-accept.name: Keeper Albagorm
1059-accept.text:
The Bloodfuries have been subdued. But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken.

Far south of the Barrens lies a land known as Thousand Needles. If you travel west in Thousand Needles until you reach the lush forest's edge of Feralas, you will find a druid named Falfindel Waywarder.

This great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale.

Send word of our need! Seek him out at once!
1059-accept.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

1070-accept.name: Sentinel Thenysil
1070-accept.text:
Hello, $N.

You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves.

Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... a sign of trouble for sure.

Would you find her and report back to me?
1070-accept.title: On Guard in Stonetalon

1073-complete.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1073-complete.text:
This'll do nicely.

If I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. Good, good... the world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
1073-complete.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1073-progress.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1073-progress.text: I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... they're vital to its creation.
1073-progress.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1074-accept.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1074-accept.text:
Here you go, stranger. Take heed with it though... it's volatile stuff.

If you're really a friend of Gaxim's, then tell him I say hello. If you're not, then have fun blowin' yerself up.
1074-accept.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1074-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1074-complete.text:
Your task has been done flawlessly, $N.

NG-5 is the unequivocal component in the recipe to ignite the wagons of dynamite.

What? Yes, dynamite... wagons of it. It's the perfect distraction, I tell you... just wait and see.
1074-complete.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1076-complete.name: Collin Mauren
1076-complete.text: Allow me just a few moments and I shall have your scroll ready for you.
1076-complete.title: Devils in Westfall

1076-progress.name: Collin Mauren
1076-progress.text: Hello, $N. Have you found the component I need?
1076-progress.title: Devils in Westfall

1077-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1077-accept.text:
Here you are, $N. This should do nicely.

Please give my regards to Gaxim when next you see him. I look forward to hearing about this adventure when it sees its completion.

Fare well.
1077-accept.title: Special Delivery for Gaxim

1077-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1077-complete.text:
This is perfect, $N! Well done.

This spell, mixed with the NG-5, shall make the perfect remote explosive.

We'll be able to create the perfect distraction for you so you can sneak in and steal the Venture Co.'s letters and engineering plans.

That will surely slow down their deforestation acts.
1077-complete.title: Special Delivery for Gaxim

1077-progress.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1077-progress.text: Haha! you're back! Do you have it? Do you have the spell?
1077-progress.title: Special Delivery for Gaxim

1078-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1078-accept.text:
Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.

Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.

If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.

Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
1078-accept.title: Retrieval for Mauren

1078-complete.name: Collin Mauren
1078-complete.text:
This is perfect, $N. Thank you greatly.

Perhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
1078-complete.title: Retrieval for Mauren

1078-progress.name: Collin Mauren
1078-progress.text:
Hello again, $N.

Have you already returned from the Vale in Stonetalon with those scales?
1078-progress.title: Retrieval for Mauren

1079-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1079-accept.text:
This is it, $N. Pay close attention. The devices are done, and ready to be used.

Take these pages--they'll explain more about the detonators and explosives, and where you should place them.

Remember, the success of your mission doesn't depend on how much destruction you cause. Plan Alpha's success depends on you bringing back the Venture Co.'s engineering plans from inside the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake.
1079-accept.title: Covert Ops - Alpha

1080-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1080-accept.text:
Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, $N.

We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.

The key is to get their letters... remember that.

The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....
1080-accept.title: Covert Ops - Beta

1080-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1080-complete.text: Incredible, $N! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
1080-complete.title: Covert Ops - Beta

1134-accept.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-accept.text:
We are not in open war with the Horde, but our peace is fragile.  We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.

One such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in Theramore, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the south.  Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the Alliance!

If this is true, then we must stop them, $N.  We must deny them their source of venom.
1134-accept.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

1134-complete.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-complete.text:
Thank you, $N.  It saddens me to order the slaughter of creatures who may not willingly aid our enemies, yet it is my duty to do so.

Your heart might weep for the pridewings you slew, my friend, but may your heart then swell in knowing that your allies are safe from the pridewings' venom.
1134-complete.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

1134-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-progress.text: Do you have the pridewing venom sacs, $N?  We cannot allow the orcs to use the beasts' poisons against us!
1134-progress.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

1198-complete.name: Unknown
1198-complete.text: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass was good to send you. There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.
1198-complete.title: In Search of Thaelrid

1200-accept.name: Unknown
1200-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in Darnassus, $N, please.
1200-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

1200-progress.name: Dawnwatcher Selgorm
1200-progress.text:
Time is a precious commodity, $c.

My role here in Darnassus is to ensure that the Argent Dawn thrives and that the evil forces encroaching upon Kalimdor are thwarted.

State your business quickly or be on your way.
1200-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

133-accept.name: Abercrombie
133-accept.text:
I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!

I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.

Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
133-accept.title: Ghoulish Effigy

133-complete.name: Abercrombie
133-complete.text: Ah, thanks.  These will do just the trick!
133-complete.title: Ghoulish Effigy

133-progress.name: Abercrombie
133-progress.text: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick!  Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
133-progress.title: Ghoulish Effigy

134-accept.name: Abercrombie
134-accept.text:
A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.

After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.

Please, $N, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
134-accept.title: Ogre Thieves

156-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-accept.text:
If you bring me some rot blossoms then I can brew you up a batch of zombie juice.

Rot blossoms grow in strange places.  In particular, I hear you can find them inside the skulls of Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends... not that I've gotten close enough to look!

The Raven Hill Cemetery and the Tranquil Gardens are both lousy with those skeletons.  You may as well get rid of them while you're looking for rot blossoms.  The town of Darkshire would be grateful.
156-accept.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

156-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-complete.text:
Good,  you got the rot blossoms.  And I'll tell Althea Ebonlocke of the Night Watch that you were killing skeletons.

Keeping the people of Darkshire safe is a grim burden for the Night Watch, and news that others are helping stem the tide of fiends in Duskwood is welcome news indeed.
156-complete.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

156-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
156-progress.text: Hi, $N.  Do you have those rot blossoms for me yet?
156-progress.title: Gather Rot Blossoms

157-complete.name: Abercrombie
157-complete.text:
Delightful!  This will do splendidly...

Here, good $N, take this as payment for your honorable deed.
157-complete.title: Deliver the Thread

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

158-accept.name: Abercrombie
158-accept.text:
I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.

And please hurry, $N.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
158-accept.title: Zombie Juice

158-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
158-complete.text: You need some Zombie Juice, do you?  Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
158-complete.title: Zombie Juice

159-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
159-accept.text:
Here's your Zombie Juice...

...and be careful with this stuff.  It's strong enough to raise the dead!
159-accept.title: Juice Delivery

159-complete.name: Abercrombie
159-complete.text:
A thousand thanks, $N.  You warm an old man's heart with your foolish-...I mean...with your kindness!

Here you are, friend.  Take this as a token of my gratitude.
159-complete.title: Juice Delivery

159-progress.name: Abercrombie
159-progress.text: I need that Zombie Juice to keep me warm on these cold, dark nights.  Did you get it for me?
159-progress.title: Juice Delivery

173-accept.name: Calor
173-accept.text:
Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

You believe yourself worthy to join us?

I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
173-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

173-complete.name: Calor
173-complete.text:
Impressive, $N. It would seem that you are capable enough to handle yourself. Perhaps a more suitable challenge could be found for one of your abilities.

It is curious though... The worgen seemed to just appear out of thin air. But then, with all the other strange creatures that have moved across our borders, I suppose it's only one of many concerns.
173-complete.title: Worgen in the Woods

174-complete.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-complete.text: This is perfect, $N.  The first step is complete!
174-complete.title: Look to the Stars

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

175-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
175-accept.text: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light.  I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
175-accept.title: Look to the Stars

175-complete.name: Blind Mary
175-complete.text: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.
175-complete.title: Look to the Stars

177-accept.name: Blind Mary
177-accept.text: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
177-accept.title: Look to the Stars

177-complete.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-complete.text: Most superb!  This will work perfectly.  Many thanks!
177-complete.title: Look to the Stars

177-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-progress.text: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
177-progress.title: Look to the Stars

181-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
181-accept.text:
Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device.  Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort.  The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.

There is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood.  If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
181-accept.title: Look to the Stars

221-accept.name: Calor
221-accept.text:
You might have noticed some larger worgen wandering around with the Shadow Weavers in the woods? From what we can tell, these Dark Runners make up the bulk of the worgen numbers.

On my rangings, I've also noticed that they have overrun the Rotting Orchard southwest of town. These worgen are a bit tougher than the last you faced.

Be on your guard.
221-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

221-complete.name: Calor
221-complete.text:
You performed well against the Dark Runners, $N. But it seems as though their numbers are inexhaustible. Every time we make progress, more spring up to refill their ranks.

What is the evil power that draws them here? Why have they come to disturb our unhappy realm...

I will put my faith in Master Carevin. No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
221-complete.title: Worgen in the Woods

222-accept.name: Calor
222-accept.text:
Your previous accomplishments have convinced me that you are ready to take on the toughest worgen infesting the woods.

Of the worgen that have made their new home here, the Vile Fangs and the Tainted Ones have proven the most dangerous. They've settled down near some of the caves and in the mine to the south.

From far away you can even see the light from their bonfires...
222-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

240-accept.name: Chef Grual
240-accept.text: And here we are - "Crab" Cakes ala Grual!
240-accept.title: Return to Jitters

240-complete.name: Jitters
240-complete.text:
Aha!  Thank you, $N.  Those really hit the spot!

And here, please let me pay you for these!
240-complete.title: Return to Jitters

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

268-accept.name: Jitters
268-accept.text:
The book you found was only half finished.  I had to leave it at Sven's farm when I fled there...

Here.  Take my completed journal to Sven.  It describes more fully what happened at his farm.

Although this journal has been my only company these past weeks, if giving it up keeps me from having to face Sven and his wrath, then I do it willingly!
268-accept.title: Return to Sven

268-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
268-complete.text: This journal explains much to me, and sets me on the path against the dark riders!  I have seen these riders in Duskwood, and have seen them speak with the wizard Morbent Fel, at the Forlorn Rowe.
268-complete.title: Return to Sven

268-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
268-progress.text: Did you find who the Shadowy Figure was?
268-progress.title: Return to Sven

275-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-accept.text:
I do not know why, but a festering grows within the Wetlands. Fen Creepers have risen. They are diseased, fevered blisters on the land, and for the fever to break they must be dispatched and allowed to settle back into the marshes.

The Fen Creepers shamble amidst the waterways of the Wetlands.
275-accept.title: Blisters on the Land

275-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
275-complete.text: This land is soothed by your efforts, and for this I will grant you a boon.
275-complete.title: Blisters on the Land

276-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
276-accept.text:
The Mosshide Gnolls have lived in the Wetlands peacefully for many years, but now grow in numbers. Their feet stamp flat the fen's bushes and flowers, and their foul axes cut too much wood to fuel their fires.

They are no longer in balance with the land. For the Wetlands to survive, the Gnolls must be reduced.

Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels. Hunt them to the south, near the Dwarven gate of Algaz. After you do this, return to me.
276-accept.title: Tramping Paws

276-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
276-complete.text: By reducing the gnolls' numbers, you have tended to the health of the Wetlands. Although my faith in your people has been taxed in the past, $r, it may yet be restored.
276-complete.title: Tramping Paws

277-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-accept.text:
The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the Wetlands, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!

Rid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.
277-accept.title: Fire Taboo

277-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-complete.text: ... thank you. I will smash these flints and cast them into the sea, so that they may never again be used to burn living wood.
277-complete.title: Fire Taboo

277-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-progress.text: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?
277-progress.title: Fire Taboo

288-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-accept.text:
I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!

We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...

...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
288-accept.title: The Third Fleet

288-complete.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-complete.text: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
288-complete.title: The Third Fleet

288-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-progress.text: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288-progress.title: The Third Fleet

289-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-accept.text:
<Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>

I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.

But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
289-accept.title: The Cursed Crew

2931-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
2931-accept.text:
Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge has need of adventurers!  He's organizing bands to reenter Gnomeregan on a data retrieval mission of top security and importance.

Castpipe might not be a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences like I am, but he's still a smart gnome so if he thinks it's important, then by my calculations there's an eighty-four percent probability that it really is important!

Those are good odds!
2931-accept.title: Castpipe's Task

294-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
294-accept.text:
The situation is severe, that much is for sure. When we uncovered these bones it attracted the Raptors. These filthy beasts killed my brethren and trapped me, Merrin and the poor Prospector up here.

Help clear the Wetlands of these Raptors, $N. Mottled Raptors and Mottled Screechers are just West of the bluff there. Kill 10 of each, if you can.

That will be a good start to the vengeance I have planned for them.
294-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

294-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
294-complete.text: Killing is a dirty business, but you did your job well, $N. If I weren't obligated to stay with the Prospector and Merrin, I'd be down there shedding blood right along side you.
294-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

295-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
295-accept.text: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst. Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws. Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!
295-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

295-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
295-complete.text: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those raptors, $N!
295-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-accept.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-accept.text:
While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.

I ask of you now one final task, $N. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.
296-accept.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-complete.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-complete.text: Thank you, $N. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. Many innocent Dwarves died at this site, simply doing their jobs. The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.
296-complete.title: Ormer's Revenge

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

299-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-accept.text:
Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy."

I fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong.

Scour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
299-accept.title: Uncovering the Past

299-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-complete.text: Ah the Goaz Stone is complete! Fine work, $N. Fine work indeed. Now I can continue with the delicate translation of this Titan script. I can make out new words already! Hmm...it says here, "Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land." This is the beginning of something epic.
299-complete.title: Uncovering the Past

299-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-progress.text: Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, $N?  Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
299-progress.title: Uncovering the Past

303-accept.name: Motley Garmason
303-accept.text:
War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the Alliance, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves.  They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.

We need you to gather force and push the front back.  If you can kill 15 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.

Now make haste!
303-accept.title: The Dark Iron War

303-complete.name: Motley Garmason
303-complete.text: You upheld your orders well, $c. You have proven yourself to be a valiant soldier and loyal servant to King Magni and for that I salute you! With the pressure you applied to the Dark Iron encampment, we now stand a chance of driving them off our lands for good. . .if only the damned reserve would show. . . .
303-complete.title: The Dark Iron War

304-accept.name: Longbraid the Grim
304-accept.text:
Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr.  My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed.  Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed.  From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of this band of thugs in the Wetlands is a warlock named Balgaras the Foul.  He is quite a coward however.  He sends his soldiers to do his bidding but stays elusive, avoiding danger.

If you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear.  I will reward you, $c.
304-accept.title: A Grim Task

304-complete.name: Longbraid the Grim
304-complete.text:
Balgaras the Foul is finally dead.  While his death will not bring back the many innocent dwarves who died needlessly by his hand, it will help to restore peace of mind to those who survived.  With Balgaras dead, the remaining Dark Iron scum should be easy enough to manage.  Now, we must wipe them out before a new leader is sent to these parts.

You have done well, $c.
304-complete.title: A Grim Task

304-progress.name: Longbraid the Grim
304-progress.text: Were you able to locate Balgaras the Foul yet, $c?  He has been evading us for quite some time.
304-progress.title: A Grim Task

305-accept.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
305-accept.text:
You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!

Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, $N. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!
305-accept.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

305-complete.name: Merrin Rockweaver
305-complete.text: Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
305-complete.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-accept.name: Merrin Rockweaver
306-accept.text:
It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.

Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.

Ormer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.

Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.
306-accept.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-complete.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-complete.text: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
306-complete.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

306-progress.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-progress.text: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?
306-progress.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

323-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
323-accept.text:
Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders.  I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength.

You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.
323-accept.title: Proving Your Worth

337-accept.name: Unknown
337-accept.text:
Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine.  Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.

It looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...
337-accept.title: An Old History Book

337-complete.name: Milton Sheaf
337-complete.text:
Oh my!  This book hasn't rested on these shelves since before the rebuilding of Stormwind, years ago.  It will have to be restored of course, it's in bad shape, but I would be honored to place it within our rare books collection.

Thank you, sir.  Please accept this as payment for returning the book!
337-complete.title: An Old History Book

337-progress.name: Milton Sheaf
337-progress.text: Ooh!  What's that old book you have there?  Can I see it??
337-progress.title: An Old History Book

377-accept.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-accept.text:
As if the neglect for the residents of Duskwood was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in Stormwind rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.

Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to Morbent Fel, a crime punishable by death.  Yet Stormwind claims Ward as their prisoner.

Assassinate Ward in The Stormwind Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
377-accept.title: Crime and Punishment

378-accept.name: Motley Garmason
378-accept.text:
You have proven your loyalty to King Magni, $c.  And your hatred for the Dark Iron scum is as great as my own.

There is a task I wish to complete myself but I am bound by honor to stay with Longbraid.  But Roggo has gathered intelligence that proves Kam Deepfury was a conspirator in the attack on the Thandol Span.  It was by Deepfury's planning that Longbraid lost his kin.

Deepfury is being held for political reasons in the Stormwind Stockade.  I want him dead, $N.  For Longbraid!  Bring me his head!
378-accept.title: The Fury Runs Deep

388-accept.name: Nikova Raskol
388-accept.text:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
388-accept.title: The Color of Blood

453-complete.name: Jitters
453-complete.text:
<Jitters sighs...>

Yes, I'm the author of that book.  You finally found me, eh?

Well if you read that journal...then you only know the half of it!
453-complete.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

453-progress.name: Jitters
453-progress.text: Who are you??  Leave me be!
453-progress.title: Finding the Shadowy Figure

4581-accept.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
4581-accept.text:
The druid Kayneth Stillwind sent word to me.  He would like a report of the happenings along our coast and in the forests surrounding Astranaar.  He fears there is a corruption moving through Ashenvale... and he may be right.

Here, take my report to him.  You will find him in the shrine of Forest Song, in the Nightsong Woods to the east.
4581-accept.title: Kayneth Stillwind

463-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
463-accept.text:
You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

And leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
463-accept.title: The Greenwarden

463-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
463-complete.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one.  Although I have many names, I answer to only a few.  But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken...for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.
463-complete.title: The Greenwarden

464-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.

Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.

We want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
464-accept.title: War Banners

469-accept.name: Einar Stonegrip
469-accept.text:
Greetings, traveler!

Don't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.

Now, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?

I'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.
469-accept.title: Daily Delivery

469-complete.name: James Halloran
469-complete.text:
Hmm, this is from Einar, right? Hasn't delivered his skins to me in person for almost a week now. No doubt it's some differences with the wife!

Maybe I'll have my wife go speak with Sida sometime...
469-complete.title: Daily Delivery

469-progress.name: James Halloran
469-progress.text: Hello there, $c. Could I interest you in a pair of boots?  Perhaps some newly cured skins?
469-progress.title: Daily Delivery

470-accept.name: Sida
470-accept.text:
On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.

I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.

The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!

I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!
470-accept.title: Digging Through the Ooze

470-complete.name: Sida
470-complete.text:
Oh, thank you, $N! I was afraid that it was lost for good!

<She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.>

Hm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.
470-complete.title: Digging Through the Ooze

472-accept.name: Harlo Barnaby
472-accept.text:
Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!

My wounds are grave, $c.  Most of the regiment was killed!  The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.

Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn.  As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back.  All went black.

I awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers.  Hope still burns within me.  Perhaps Longbraid is still alive!  See if you can find him near Dun Modr, $r!
472-accept.title: Fall of Dun Modr

472-complete.name: Longbraid the Grim
472-complete.text:
What brave $c sends word from Menethil?  Ah $N, they call you.

You bring hope to a hopeless situation.  'Tis good news indeed that young Harlo survived.  While fleeing he received a grievous wound.  We had but little time to send him on his way on the back of the only surviving steed with the regiment.

But now we face a perilous situation.  Dun Modr has fallen and we are but a shadow of the great regiment we once were.
472-complete.title: Fall of Dun Modr

4728-complete.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-complete.text: Ah, I believe you discovered one that was originally being examined by the Explorer's League.  They have a presence here in Darkshore, and they had mentioned that they were studying one of the beached creatures until they were chased out by the murlocs.  You appear to have succeeded where we both have not.  Please - accept this honorarium on behalf of the Temple of the Moon.
4728-complete.title: Beached Sea Creature

4728-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4728-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  What brings you back to Auberdine?  Are you here to report on another discovery, perhaps?
4728-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4740-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4740-complete.text:
Well, looks like you're here to more than just inquire!  The citizens will be delighted to know that tonight they will sleep a little bit more soundly and safer.

You've acted as the executioner of justice for the people of Auberdine today, $N.  For that, I would like to offer you this as a suitable reward... for a true hero of the Auberdine people.
4740-complete.title: WANTED: Murkdeep!

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

5321-accept.name: Kerlonian Evershade
5321-accept.text:
I was on my way to Maestra's Post to meet Liladris Moonriver, but I decided to stop here and take a short nap. Ever since I awoke from the emerald dream, I have been so sleepy...

<yawn>

And I can't find my things anywhere! Would you mind helping me find them?

I understand that Maestra's Post is south of here, along the road in Ashenvale. I had come from that way...

Lastly, I may fall asleep so if you ever need to wake me, please use my horn. You'll find it in the chest here.
5321-accept.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened

5321-complete.name: Liladris Moonriver
5321-complete.text:
Oh, I am so happy Kerlonian is safe! And I'm sure I'll find him sleeping somewhere around here, won't I? Eventually...

Thank you for showing him the way, $N.
5321-complete.title: The Sleeper Has Awakened

538-accept.name: Milton Sheaf
538-accept.text:
$N.  If you don't mind a long journey then I have a task for you, to again help Stormwind fill its library.

The old kingdom of Alterac fell after the great war, and it had a large collection of books.  It's a tragedy that the city is ruined, but even more tragic is all of their knowledge lost!  We must recover what we can.

Southshore is the closest town to the Ruins of Alterac.  Go there and speak with Loremaster Dibbs.  He can direct you to the ruins, and to what books may be found there.
538-accept.title: Southshore

56-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-accept.text:
As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!
56-accept.title: The Night Watch

56-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-complete.text: Splendid, $N.  For your service to the people of Darkshire you shall be rewarded.
56-complete.title: The Night Watch

57-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
57-accept.text: $N, I'm getting reports of an undead infestation in the forest!  If you're up to the job, journey to the Raven Hill graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.  There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.  The undead must be driven from Duskwood!
57-accept.title: The Night Watch

57-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
57-complete.text: The people of Darkshire thank you, $N.  You have proven yourself to be a great ally of The Night Watch.
57-complete.title: The Night Watch

5713-accept.name: Sentinel Aynasha
5713-accept.text:
I was traveling to Auberdine with an important message when I was attacked by the furbolg Marosh and his trackers. During the attack I was poisoned, leaving me barely able to stand. I can make an antidote, but it will take time before it is ready.

I would ask that you defend me until I can apply the antidote. I will aid you with my bow as best I can.

Should we survive, I will be able deliver my message to Auberdine, while you speak with Onaeya at Maestra's Post to inform her of this incident.
5713-accept.title: One Shot. One Kill.

5713-complete.name: Sentinel Onaeya
5713-complete.text: You bring most welcome news $c. It is good to hear that Aynasha is alive and well thanks to you. I would hope that you might accept a reward for your valor. May Elune watch over you and light your path.
5713-complete.title: One Shot. One Kill.

58-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
58-accept.text: The situation in Raven Hill is still grim.  The safety of Darkshire is in your hands, $N.  I don't have enough Watchers to keep the town safe.  We need you to dispatch for Raven Hill yet again and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders!
58-accept.title: The Night Watch

631-accept.name: Rhag Garmason
631-accept.text:
A tremendous explosion roared through the hills. 'Twas horrible, I tell you!

Good soldiers died defending the Thandol Span. Longbraid says we'll take revenge on the Dark Irons before all is said and done.

We're in a world of hurt though and I don't see any reinforcements in sight. Longbraid sent Ol' Rustlocke to scout the eastern bridge to see if we could secure it.

That was days ago. We haven't the manpower to search for him with Dun Modr under siege.

Perhaps you can find him...
631-accept.title: The Thandol Span

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

68-accept.name: Unknown
68-accept.text: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
68-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

88756-accept.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
88756-accept.text:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756-accept.title: Bring Back a Bang

90-complete.name: Chef Grual
90-complete.text: Very nice work, $N!  Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!
90-complete.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

93-complete.name: Chef Grual
93-complete.text:
Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there!  Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...

And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
93-complete.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

94241-accept.name: Unknown
94241-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Dark Leather Tunic, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94241-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Tunic

944-accept.name: Onu
944-accept.text:
It is strange that the naga are here, in Darkshore.  But stranger still...are the Twilight's Hammer.  That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth.  Lords defeated long ago.

The Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell.

Go there and look for more Twilight's Hammer cultists.

Take this phial of scrying.  Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive.  Then speak to me through the bowl.
944-accept.title: The Master's Glaive

944-progress.name: Unknown
944-progress.text:
The Master's Glaive, $N.

Go there, then speak with me again.
944-progress.title: The Master's Glaive

95646-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-accept.text:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646-accept.title: Horrors in the Highland

95646-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-complete.text: It is worse than I feared. An ancient energy stirs. It would be most wise for you to carry word to your eager excavators to stop digging, for their own safety.
95646-complete.title: Horrors in the Highland

95646-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-progress.text: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646-progress.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647-accept.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95647-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-complete.text: I thought we were done for! Something upset the wildlife around here and our excavation team was overwhelmed. Thank you for helping us with those spiders.
95647-complete.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95772-complete.name: Dorin Songblade
95772-complete.text: This dwarf bears a striking resemblance to Dorin Songblade. The gun in his hands has the letters "DLS" carved into the stock.
95772-complete.title: Songblade Search

95795-accept.name: Unknown
95795-accept.text:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795-accept.title: Fallen in the Fen

95809-accept.name: Unknown
95809-accept.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809-accept.title: Heartwoven

95809-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-complete.text:
Goodness, that sounds terrible!

By the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.

<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>

I'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.
95809-complete.title: Heartwoven

95809-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-progress.text: I'm more than worried about him!
95809-progress.title: Heartwoven

95810-accept.name: Unknown
95810-accept.text:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810-accept.title: Lost Relic Carry

95810-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
95810-complete.text:
Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there. 

Well, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.
95810-complete.title: Lost Relic Carry

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

98245-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-complete.text: These'll make a beautiful set of awls. Thank ye.
98245-complete.title: Razormaw Needling

98245-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-progress.text: Any luck prying those teeth off? I need 'em whole so they don't snap on the scales right away.
98245-progress.title: Razormaw Needling

98246-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-complete.text:
They're not for me plan--they're to feed Bassbeak. She's of no help at all if she's hungry, trust me. She might be more dangerous than the orcs if she's ticked off!

Untainted food can be hard to come by in these lands as of late...
98246-complete.title: Trying Times

98246-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-progress.text: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.
98246-progress.title: Trying Times

98282-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-complete.text:
Oh, perfect! This is exactly what I need. You're a real hero, you know.

Please, I'd be remiss if I didn't share some of the fruits of your labors with you. Stay safe out there!
98282-complete.title: Alchemical Hazards

98282-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-progress.text: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!
98282-progress.title: Alchemical Hazards

98283-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
98283-accept.text:
The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.

I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.

It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.

Carnage will come. Bring me its head.
98283-accept.title: Carnage

98283-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
98283-complete.text:
Carnage's death will bring balance to his pack. Perhaps it will buy enough time for the greater ecosystem they support.

We shall see, but I thank you for the effort regardless.
98283-complete.title: Carnage

98283-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
98283-progress.text:
The Rotclaw came down from their homes in Loch Modan, now driven mad.

Such a waste of life's boon.
98283-progress.title: Carnage

98291-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98291-accept.text:
I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, $N. Or at least learn a thing or two.

Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.

Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.

I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.
98291-accept.title: Death to the Dragonmaw

986-complete.name: Terenthis
986-complete.text:
These will do nicely, $N. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.

Give me a few moments, then return to me.

Oh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.
986-complete.title: A Lost Master

986-progress.name: Terenthis
986-progress.text: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.
986-progress.title: A Lost Master

98815-complete.name: James Halloran
98815-complete.text:
These are some of the most impressive hides I've ever held; these will make spectacular detailing on all of my fine trim. Thank you, $N. 

Try these on and take one you'd like in trade.
98815-complete.title: Highland Hides

98815-progress.name: James Halloran
98815-progress.text: Welcome back, $c. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
98815-progress.title: Highland Hides

98824-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
98824-accept.text:
With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.

I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by $N! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.

High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.

Good find!
98824-accept.title: Prehistoric Prism

990-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
990-complete.text:
Ah, a $c from Darkshore. Selarin has done well to send you here so quickly, $N. I wish your trip here wasn't under such dire stress. Perhaps with your help we can improve matters.

I would start my visit by speaking to the other citizens of Astranaar. Some could surely use your aid.
990-complete.title: Trek to Ashenvale

991-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
991-accept.text:
$N, a longtime friend of mine is also aiding the Sentinels here in Ashenvale, but he has yet to return.

He had leads on finding an item that he thought could slow the furbolg attacks on our people--a rod created by a now-dead, evil wizard.

Before he left here, he mentioned seeking out a gem for the rod.

He mentioned the gem possibly being hidden at the shrine in Lake Falathim at the base of the mountain to the west. The gem was being held there before it was overrun.

Find my friend, $N, please.
991-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

991-complete.name: Teronis' Corpse
991-complete.text:
Teronis' body lies broken atop the island. For some unknown reason, the murlocs have left it alone.

The deep slashes across his corpse obviously came from the weapons and claws of the murlocs.
991-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

993-accept.name: Terenthis
993-accept.text:
The cloak is complete, $N. The time has come to find Volcor. I can only hope we are in time.

The cloak's magic, once invoked, will not last long; perhaps five minutes. It will be up to you to know when to use it: I would suggest waiting until you find Grimclaw.

If what he has told me is true, you will find his master in a cave south of here. Grimclaw will be alongside the road waiting for you. Signal to him by waving when you see him, and he'll point the way towards his master.
993-accept.title: A Lost Master

993-complete.name: Volcor
993-complete.text:
Wonderful! Terenthis found someone to help me.

And look, a moonstalker cloak...<cough> Oh... that hurts. Thank you, $N.

The furbolgs wounded me before I managed to evade them. Give me a moment, and I should be fine to talk some more.
993-complete.title: A Lost Master

994-accept.name: Volcor
994-accept.text:
All right, $N, force it is. Let's get out of here as soon as you're ready. We'll fight our way down to the road--Grimclaw should still be there. Once there, we can part ways.

Terenthis will want to hear your version of the story immediately, so head to Auberdine after we make it out of here.
994-accept.title: Escape Through Force

994-complete.name: Terenthis
994-complete.text: $N! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in Darkshore and beyond.
994-complete.title: Escape Through Force
